model.rf_reference_scope: convention chosen from stated 80 Hz artificial detuning relative to 50230 Hz; opposite convention changes phase sign only

microscopic_context.scope: couplings measured in NV-; transfer to NV0 not independently established; not used to predict envelope

model.parameter_scope: 3 envelope parameters fitted only to first 9 envelope points; 2 linear Ramsey amplitude/phase coefficients fitted only to first 5 X points; frequency fixed from separate NMR fit

split.scope: retrospective chronological split chosen after dataset inspection; not a new independent experiment

fit.ramsey: weighted linear least squares in damped cosine/sine; no frequency or offset fit

gate.scope: descriptive consistency diagnostic using source error bars only; no calibration uncertainty propagation, covariance or p-value
